北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感 32℃，请注意防晒补水，别中暑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, feels 32℃. Stay hydrated, protect from sun, avoid heatstroke!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，湿度 94%，体感略闷热，多通风保持舒爽哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with 94% humidity. It feels muggy, ventilate to stay cool.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 94%，无风闷热，注意防潮。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels 30℃, 94% humidity, no wind, muggy. Mind dampness.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 32℃，湿度高，出门记得带伞防雨防晒。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels 32℃, high humidity. Bring umbrella for rain/sun.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，湿度 79%，体感略闷，多喝水，保持身体舒畅哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy with 79% humidity. It feels warm, drink water and stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 30℃，湿度 82%，出门别忘带雨具哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels 30℃ with 82% humidity. Don't forget your umbrella.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，湿度 100%！体感闷热，注意除湿，保持好心情。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with 100% humidity! It's muggy, dehumidify and keep spirits high.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴朗，体感 34℃！天气炎热干燥，记得多补充水分。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels like 34℃! It's hot and dry, remember to hydrate.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 32℃，湿度 75%，注意防暑降温哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is partly cloudy, feels 32℃ with 75% humidity. Stay cool and prevent heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 31℃，天气有点热，外出注意防晒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels 31℃. It's a bit hot, remember sun protection.
西安.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗，体感 34℃！天气炎热，防晒补水是关键哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny and feels 34℃! It's very hot, sun protection and hydration are key.
重庆.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，湿度 90%，体感闷热，注意防潮和保持通风。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy with 90% humidity. It feels muggy, dehumidify and ventilate.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，湿度 99%！体感微凉但潮湿，注意除湿哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is partly cloudy with 99% humidity! It feels cool but damp, dehumidify.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感 19℃，凉爽宜人，出门记得添衣别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels 19℃. It's pleasantly cool, dress appropriately.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，湿度 90%，风力 4级，出门要注意防雨防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with 90% humidity and 4-grade wind. Be mindful of rain and wind.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，湿度 89%，体感略闷热，出门记得带伞哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy with 89% humidity. It feels a bit muggy, remember your umbrella.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，湿度 85%，开车慢行，注意交通安全。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is foggy with 85% humidity. Drive slowly and stay safe on the road.
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
